summary: Say where a replication projection chunk's writer loan spends its hold: each long hold of that loan in the writer-hold row of GET /v1/client/request-latency gains stages (begin, chunk-read, incremental, replay, after-projection, health, commit, rollback, callbacks, release) and unattributed_ms, and its hold in progress names the stage it is in

replay.detail: Projection results, ordering, errors and the frontier are unchanged; the stages only time the existing steps.

schema.detail: In-memory accounting only; no database changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; members may upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: Additive: long_holds rows for the projection loan gain stages and unattributed_ms, and its in_progress row gains stage. Every other row is unchanged. st doctor reads only fields that already exist.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

manual.detail: Always on: about 12 to 16 clock reads per projection chunk; other loans pay one thread-local read.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing is persisted.
